# anti-hall

> A Claude Code marketplace plugin plus a Codex-native port that makes coding agents verify
> before they claim. It injects a verify-first protocol at session start (re-injected after
> compaction and into every subagent), a short per-turn nudge, and mechanical guards that
> cannot be argued with: no AI commit self-credit, no silent force-push, coordinator
> command/edit delegation, anti-fork-bomb, anti-speculation (lexical, claim-ledger, opt-in
> LLM judge), task-list discipline, and a TTL'd user-override escape hatch
> (`~/.anti-hall/skip.json`). Optional parts: a two-line statusline, an MCP-orphan reaper,
> the Jev classifier, and DevSwarm multi-workspace coordination (dormant unless DevSwarm is
> in use). Pure Node built-ins, macOS + Linux, Node >= 22 on PATH (hooks silently no-op
> without it). Windows is not supported.

anti-hall targets four failure modes of coding agents: eagerness (acting before
investigating), hallucination (unverified facts stated as truth), fix-before-diagnosis, and
fake completion (claiming done without running the check). The always-on protocol text
itself (Iron Law, rationalization table, positive rules, orchestration rules) is mirrored
in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). This file is the condensed catalog of every component; history
is in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

**New in 0.108.0:** automatic handover at 85% context (`auto-handover.js` +
`auto-handover-pause-nag.js`); one settings store for everything
(`~/.anti-hall/settings.json`, `/anti-hall:settings`, `scripts/settings.js`); repairs on
every plugin reload/new version (`repair-on-reload.js`); version alerts that tell you to
update or just reload; Jev real cost tracking, precision labels, budget watch, credit
balance and opt-in audit snippets; DevSwarm: the app database as ground truth, a capability
gate (version + runtime detection) on every DevSwarm surface, auto-archive of proven-done
workspaces (DevSwarm >= 2.5.3), owner-approved prune, message retention, screenshot sync.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add talas9/anti-hall
/plugin install anti-hall@anti-hall
```

Codex: `node plugins/anti-hall/codex/install-codex.js` (project) or `--global`. Update with
`/anti-hall:update` (Claude) or the `anti-hall-update` skill (Codex), then `/reload-plugins`.

## Hooks (plugins/anti-hall/hooks/, registered in hooks.json)

All fail-open. "Codex" = also registered by the Codex port (`codex/hooks/hooks.json`).
Env names are the per-hook switches; every user-facing one is also a setting (see Settings).

| Event (matcher) | Hook | What it does | Codex | Switch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SessionStart | verify-first-full.js | Injects the verify-first foundation: Iron Law, rationalization table, positive rules, scope & fidelity, output-presentation rule K. | ✓ | — |
| SessionStart | verify-first-orch.js | Injects the orchestration ruleset (rules A–N, DevSwarm-Primary rule W); split out for the ~10k injection cap. | ✓ | — |
| SessionStart | version-alert.js | Tells the user when anti-hall is behind: remote newer → update then reload; plugin-cache mirror newer → reload only. Once per session; 2 h detached refresh. | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_VERSION_ALERT=off` |
| SessionStart | claude-cli-version.js | Flags Claude Code CLI drift from the version anti-hall's harness KB was verified against. | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION_ALERT=off` |
| SessionStart | devswarm-version.js | Flags DevSwarm/hivecontrol version drift (DevSwarm only). | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM_VERSION_ALERT=off` |
| SessionStart | repo-self-drift.js | Network-free self-check of anti-hall's own repo docs vs. code counts. | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_REPO_SELF_DRIFT=off` |
| SessionStart | fable-availability.js | Detects Fable model availability from the local model cache; silent unless available. | — | — |
| SessionStart | codex-availability.js | Caches whether a `codex` executable is on PATH (`~/.anti-hall/codex-availability.json`). | ✓ | — |
| SessionStart | devswarm-child-role.js | DevSwarm child: reminds it to self-report idleness over the mesh. | ✓ | — |
| SessionStart | progress-prune.js | Archives stale per-session progress files into the history ledger, deleting only after the append succeeds; throttled per cwd. | ✓ | — |
| SessionStart | handover-resume.js | Surfaces the latest `.anti-hall/handovers/` entry after startup, `/clear` or compaction. | ✓ | — |
| SessionStart | emit-dedupe-reset.js | Marks a context loss so repeated per-turn blocks are re-emitted. | ✓ | — |
| SessionStart | defect-nudge.js | Once-a-day count of open defect reports (counts only, never reporter text). | ✓ | — |
| SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit | repair-on-reload.js | When any repair migration isn't stamped for the running version, spawns one detached `doctor.js --repair --quiet` (lock-guarded). | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_REPAIR_ON_RELOAD=off` |
| UserPromptSubmit | verify-first.js | Short rotating one-line verify-first nudge. | ✓ | — |
| UserPromptSubmit | task-tracker.js | Task-list discipline directive plus a freshness note when tasks are open/stale. | ✓ | — |
| UserPromptSubmit | limit-conserve-inject.js | Token-conservation nudge at the usage threshold (auto mode reads the OMC usage cache). | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_LIMIT_CONSERVE`, `ANTIHALL_LIMIT_THRESHOLD` |
| UserPromptSubmit | auto-handover.js | At 85% context (known window) or 170k tokens: write a handover unasked, tell the user, urge `/compact`/`/clear`; milestone nags every +5 points; unknown window → one soft advisory only. | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_AUTO_HANDOVER_PCT` (`0` = off) |
| UserPromptSubmit | devswarm-parent-inbox.js | DevSwarm Primary: per-turn workspace table (app titles, sidebar order, finish/PR state, unread) and neglect nags. | ✓ | — |
| UserPromptSubmit | devswarm-child-turn.js | DevSwarm child: turn-authored heartbeat, keep-parent-updated reminder, unread-inbox surfacing. | ✓ | — |
| TaskCreated, TaskCompleted | task-lifecycle-log.js | Appends task events to `.anti-hall/history/<date>/<session>.md`. | — | — |
| SubagentStart | verify-first-subagent.js | Re-injects the Iron Law and scope rules into every subagent (no orchestration block). | — | — |
| PreToolUse (Bash) | git-guard.js | Blocks AI self-credit in commits and `gh` PR/issue/release bodies; blocks force-push (`--force`, `-f`, `--force-with-lease`, `+refspec`). | ✓ | named skip only |
| PreToolUse (Bash) | command-guard.js | Coordinator must delegate heavy commands; blocks DevSwarm destructive verbs and native hivecontrol messaging. | ✓ | — |
| PreToolUse (Bash) | merge-gate.js | Opt-in: blocks auto-merge without a recorded review. | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_MERGE_GATE=on` |
| PreToolUse (Bash) | scan-throttle.js | Prefixes user-listed heavy scan commands with `taskpolicy`/`nice` (no built-in patterns). | — | `ANTI_HALL_THROTTLE_PATTERNS` |
| PreToolUse (Write/Edit/MultiEdit) | api-guard.js | Blocks writing a `module.attr` the installed runtime doesn't have (stdlib/builtins by default). | — | `ANTIHALL_API_GUARD_THIRDPARTY=1` |
| PreToolUse (Write/Edit/MultiEdit) | ship-it-guard.js | Opt-in: blocks hard-risk code edits with no `PLAN.md`. | — | `ANTIHALL_SHIPIT_GATE=on` |
| PreToolUse (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit) | edit-guard.js | Coordinator must delegate file edits (root-anchored allowlist for docs/state). | — | `ANTIHALL_EDIT_GUARD_ALLOW` |
| PreToolUse (Read) | inbox-read-guard.js | Blocks a direct Read of a raw DevSwarm inbox file (use the CLI). | — | — |
| PreToolUse (SendMessage) | devswarm-comms-guard.js | Blocks `SendMessage` to a peer session that is a registered DevSwarm workspace (mesh only); never blocks subagent steering. | — | — |
| PreToolUse (Agent/Task) | model-routing-guard.js | Routes spawns to the cheapest fitting model: blocks a mechanical spawn with no model (strict default), advises on flagship + mechanical. | — | `ANTIHALL_MODEL_ROUTING=advisory` |
| PreToolUse (Agent/Task) | swarm-guard.js | Anti-fork-bomb: spawn-rate cap + real free-memory check. | — | — |
| PreToolUse (Agent/Task) | phase-tracker.js | Records spawns for the statusline and the Stop guards. | — | — |
| PostToolUse (Bash) | output-verify-guard.js | Advisory: flags a pass claim next to failing runner output. | — | `ANTIHALL_OUTPUT_VERIFY_GUARD=off` |
| PostToolUse (Bash) | devswarm-parent-reply-tracker.js | Records replies to child `--question`s for the parent gate. | ✓ | — |
| PostToolUse (Bash) | devswarm-child-drain.js | DevSwarm child: mid-turn inbox drain (throttled). | ✓ | — |
| PostToolUseFailure (Bash) | failure-root-cause-nudge.js | One-line pointer to `/anti-hall:root-cause` after a failed command. | — | `ANTIHALL_FAILURE_ROOT_CAUSE_NUDGE=off` |
| Stop | task-guard.js | Blocks once when ending with genuinely open tasks. | ✓ | — |
| Stop | tasklist-guard.js | Requires a live task list + fresh progress file for non-trivial work. | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_TASKLIST_WORK_THRESHOLD` |
| Stop | speculation-guard.js | Tier 2: flags hedge-word speculation (optionally Jev-backed). | ✓ | — |
| Stop | claim-ledger.js | Tier 2.5, ledger-only (never blocks): records confident claims with no supporting evidence in the turn. | ✓ | — |
| Stop | speculation-judge.js | Tier 3, opt-in: LLM judge for confident unverified assertions. | ✓ | `ANTIHALL_SEMANTIC_JUDGE=1` |
| Stop | codex-nudge.js | Once per session: suggests an independent Codex review of substantial code. | — | `ANTIHALL_CODEX_NUDGE=off` |
| Stop | auto-handover-pause-nag.js | Delivers the handover directive once at a Stop if a long turn never reached a new prompt; afterwards, at a quiet pause, reminds at most once per 15 min. | ✓ | autoHandover.nag |
| Stop | devswarm-parent-gate.js | DevSwarm Primary: blocks ending the turn with child unread/stale/escalated or own unread (capped). | ✓ | — |
| Stop | devswarm-child-gate.js | DevSwarm child: must heartbeat/self-report before idling (capped). | ✓ | — |
| PreCompact | precompact-snapshot.js | Before every compaction writes a mechanical `PRECOMPACT-<n>.md` (git state, task list, last 10 user messages, newest handover pointer); never blocks. | ✓ | — |
| SessionEnd | session-end-mcp-reaper.js | On clean exit, reaps MCP servers orphaned by earlier crashed sessions (audit-logged). | — | `ANTI_HALL_SESSION_END_REAPER=0` |

Shared libraries (not hooks): `verify-first-core.js`, `coordinator-detect.js`, `skip-guard.js`,
`omc-detect.js`, `limit-conserve.js`; `hooks/lib/`: `settings.js` + `settings-schema.js`
(the settings store), `context-pct.js` + `context-pct-store.js` (context %),
`auto-handover-config.js`/`-state.js`, `jev-client.js`/`jev-assist.js`/`jev-triage.js`,
`defect-store.js`, `emit-dedupe.js`, `state-prune.js`, `doctor-repair.js`,
`devswarm-detect.js`, `devswarm-wake.js`, `transcript-tail.js`.

## Claude skills (plugins/anti-hall/skills/, invoke as /anti-hall:<name>)

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| root-cause | Evidence-driven debugging: prove the original and root cause before any fix. |
| orchestration | Non-blocking coordinator/worker swarm; background + parallel subagents. |
| deadly-loop | Reviewer + Auditor + Critic debate and fix waves until no new P0/P1. |
| deadly-loop-multi | The deadly-loop trio multiplied 2–4× with diversified lenses. |
| ship-it | One workflow from one-line fix to multi-phase feature; rigor scaled to blast radius. |
| simplify | Behavior-preserving simplification of recent code. |
| debt | Register and audit deliberate technical debt markers. |
| handover | Minimal-but-lossless session handover for a fresh session. |
| doctor | Health check and `--repair` (hooks present, guards fire, companions, DevSwarm, split stores). |
| update | Self-update, changelog delta, repairs, then `/reload-plugins`. |
| activate | One-shot first-run setup. |
| install-statusline | Installs the two-line statusline. |
| settings | Show/change any setting (`~/.anti-hall/settings.json`), including auto-handover. |
| system-briefing | The operator guide: glossary, hard rules, every skill/CLI verb/setting with defaults, plus a live inventory of what is installed. SessionStart points agents at it. |
| devswarm | DevSwarm integration: mesh CLI, recovery, auto-archive/prune, retention, app DB, screenshot sync. |
| jev | Jev classifier activation, modes per integration, report. |
| defects | File/list/show/rule on anti-hall defect reports. |
| flutter-debug | Agent-driven Flutter run/hot-reload/drive/screenshot debug loop (plus the `flutter-debug` agent). |

`skills/MODEL-POLICY.md` is the shared model roster (Claude + Codex tables).

## Scripts and companions

| Path | Verbs / use |
|---|---|
| scripts/settings.js | `show [--all] [--section s] [--json]`, `get`, `set`, `reset` — the settings store CLI. |
| scripts/auto-handover-config.js | `get \| set <1-99> \| off \| on \| max-tokens <n> \| nag on\|off \| nag-step <n> \| nag-quiet <n>` — alias over `autoHandover.*`. |
| scripts/devswarm.js | The DevSwarm mesh CLI (JSON out): register/ensure, heartbeat, send, inbox, roster, mesh, gate, spawn, merge, archive, reconcile, diagnose, healthcheck, app-state, app-sync, sync-ui, auto-archive, prune-archived, retention, … (`help` lists all). |
| scripts/devswarm-store-leak-report.js | Read-only audit of DevSwarm store growth/leaks. |
| scripts/jev-setup.js | `status \| enable \| disable \| set-key \| test \| mode` (`--transport vercel\|typesafe`). |
| scripts/jev-report.js | Per-integration calls, precision, cost/efficiency, budget status, credit balance; `label`, `prune-audit`. |
| scripts/defect.js | `report \| list \| show \| rule \| archive` for the defect channel. |
| scripts/briefing.js | Backs system-briefing. |
| scripts/capability-scan.js | Harness capability scan (see the update skill). |
| scripts/harvest-debt.js | Backs the debt skill. |
| scripts/migrate-state.js | State-layout migration CLI (see the update skill). |
| skills/update/scripts/update.js | The updater (`--check`); re-execs the freshly pulled version for post-pull stages. |
| hooks/doctor.js | Doctor (`--repair`, `--quiet`). |
| companion/mcp-reaper.js + install-reaper.js | Opt-in interval job killing orphaned MCP servers (macOS LaunchAgent / systemd user timer). |
| companion/devswarm-supervisor.js + install-devswarm-supervisor.js | Opt-in DevSwarm sweep: liveness poke/escalate (never kills), app-DB sync, auto-archive, message retention. |
| companion/devswarm-ingest.js + install-devswarm-ingest.js | Opt-in per-project ingest daemon (`hivecontrol workspace monitor` → mesh store). |
| companion/devswarm-migrate.js | Legacy DevSwarm state → store migration. |
| companion/devswarm-recover.js | The only DevSwarm path that kills: on-demand, one named workspace. |
| statusline/ | `statusline.js` dispatcher, `statusline-rich.js` (line 1), `phase-bar.js` (line 2; also persists the context window for auto-handover), `phase.js` (progress writer), `install-statusline.js`/`uninstall-statusline.js`. |
| monitors/monitors.json | Registers `devswarm-wake-watch.js` (Monitor-based wake). |

## Settings (user-facing; `/anti-hall:settings`, `scripts/settings.js show --all` for advanced)

Store: `~/.anti-hall/settings.json`. Precedence: env > settings.json > `/config`
(plugin.json userConfig) > legacy file (e.g. `jev.json`) > default; legacy outranks `/config`
until the one-time migration is stamped. Numbers clamp to schema bounds.

| Setting | Default | Env |
|---|---|---|
| autoHandover.enabled / pct / maxTokens / nag / nagStepPct / nagQuietMin | true / 85 / 170000 / true / 5 / 15 | `ANTIHALL_AUTO_HANDOVER_PCT`, `ANTIHALL_AUTO_HANDOVER_MAX_TOKENS` |
| guards.mergeGate / shipitGate | false / false | `ANTIHALL_MERGE_GATE`, `ANTIHALL_SHIPIT_GATE` |
| guards.outputVerifyGuard / failureRootCauseNudge / repoSelfDrift / emitDedupe | true | `ANTIHALL_OUTPUT_VERIFY_GUARD`, … |
| guards.stashGuard | false | `ANTIHALL_STASH_GUARD` |
| versionAlerts.antiHall / claudeCli / devswarm | true | `ANTIHALL_VERSION_ALERT`, `ANTIHALL_CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION_ALERT`, `ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM_VERSION_ALERT` |
| updates.quiet | false | `ANTIHALL_UPDATE_QUIET` |
| limitConserve.mode / threshold | auto / 85 | `ANTIHALL_LIMIT_CONSERVE`, `ANTIHALL_LIMIT_THRESHOLD` |
| jev.enabled / transport / judgeModel / semanticJudge | false / vercel / claude-haiku-4-5 / false | `ANTIHALL_JEV`, `ANTIHALL_JUDGE_MODEL`, `ANTIHALL_SEMANTIC_JUDGE` |
| jev.budget.mode / usdPerDay / usdPerWeek / minCreditUsd | unlimited / — / — / — | — (watch only warns; never disables Jev) |
| jev.audit.snippets, jev.prices (advanced) | false, — | `ANTIHALL_JEV_AUDIT_SNIPPETS` |
| devswarm.hivecontrol / supervisorMode / requiredGates / inboxCmd | "" / auto / done,merged,tests_passed / "" | `ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM_*` |
| devswarm.autoArchive.mode (+ idleMin, maxPerSweep advanced) | on (30, 3) | `ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM_AUTO_ARCHIVE_MODE` |
| devswarm.retention.days / maxStoreMB / keepPerPartition / archive / archiveMaxMB (advanced) | 30 / 100 / 200 / true / 200 | `ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM_RETENTION_*` |
| statusline.base / noEmail | "" / false | `ANTIHALL_STATUSLINE_BASE`, `ANTIHALL_STATUSLINE_NO_EMAIL` |
| codexNudge.enabled | true | `ANTIHALL_CODEX_NUDGE` |
| defects.defaultProj | "" | `ANTIHALL_DEFECT_PROJ` |

Env-only switches: `ANTIHALL_REPAIR_ON_RELOAD=off`, `ANTIHALL_MODEL_ROUTING=advisory`,
`ANTIHALL_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS`, `ANTI_HALL_THROTTLE_PATTERNS`,
`ANTI_HALL_SESSION_END_REAPER=0`, `ANTIHALL_REAPER_MATCH/EXCLUDE`,
`ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM_APP_DB` (path or `off`), `ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM_APP_SYNC=0`. The ~35 DevSwarm
tuning knobs are advanced settings (`show --section devswarm --all`).

## State files (~/.anti-hall/)

| Path | Written by / for |
|---|---|
| settings.json | the settings store |
| skip.json | per-guard TTL'd user override (git-guard must be named explicitly) |
| jev.json | legacy Jev config (still read as a fallback; never deleted) |
| update-sweep-state.json | per-migration repair markers (update, doctor, repair-on-reload) |
| version-check.json, version-alert-reload.json | version-alert cache and reload-nudge dedupe |
| auto-handover/<session>.json, context-pct/<session>.json | auto-handover latch; statusline context window |
| codex-availability.json, phase-state.json, agents/ | availability cache; statusline phase; spawn heartbeats |
| claim-ledger/, approvals/, defects/ | claim ledger; merge approvals; defect channel |
| logs/ | hook/companion logs (jev-assist, jev-audit, devswarm-retention, devswarm-prune, repair-on-reload-*) |
| devswarm/ | mesh stores, summaries, heartbeats, capabilities.json, app-state.json, archive/ (retention) |

Per-project: `.anti-hall/progress/`, `.anti-hall/history/`, `.anti-hall/handovers/`.

## DevSwarm coordination (optional)

Dormant unless in a DevSwarm session (`DEVSWARM_REPO_ID`) or an opt-in companion is
installed. Primary and children talk only through the per-project mesh store via
`scripts/devswarm.js` (native hivecontrol messaging and `SendMessage` to workspaces are
blocked). Recovery is layered and never auto-kills: child self-report → supervisor poke →
escalate to the parent; only `devswarm-recover.js` kills. The DevSwarm desktop app's own
SQLite DB is read (read-only, never message bodies or credentials) as the ground truth for
open/archived state, titles, sidebar order, PRs and session identity. Every DevSwarm
surface passes the capability gate (`companion/lib/devswarm-capabilities.js`: minimum
version + `--help`/schema detection); a missing surface sleeps and doctor names it.
Auto-archive (default on, DevSwarm >= 2.5.3) archives only workspaces proven done, merged,
clean, drained, unfocused and idle, always by explicit workspace id; deleting archived
workspaces needs the owner's approval of an exact list. Message retention archives old
message bodies to gzip, then prunes them. Full reference:
[docs/KB-devswarm-hivecontrol.md](docs/KB-devswarm-hivecontrol.md),
[docs/KB-devswarm-app-db.md](docs/KB-devswarm-app-db.md).

## Manifests, tests, release

- [plugins/anti-hall/.claude-plugin/plugin.json](plugins/anti-hall/.claude-plugin/plugin.json) — the only version authority (also `plugins/anti-hall/.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, bumped together); [.claude-plugin/marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json).
- [tests/](tests/) — zero-dependency `node --test`; v0.108.0 end-to-end scenarios in `tests/e2e/v0108/`. CI: ubuntu + macOS × Node 22/24 ([.github/workflows/test.yml](.github/workflows/test.yml)).
- [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) — bump both manifests + CHANGELOG, commit, tag, GitHub Release.
